north_korea.name: North Korea

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 12 evening scan: Reuters reports Russia launched more than 200 drones at Ukraine hours after a US-mediated ceasefire ended, while both sides exchange violation accusations and operations continue. Active signals: military buildup, ceasefire diplomacy. Raw probability 88%. Rising/imminent.
